project_name: Raghu M - GISEC 2026 Executive Digital Business Card
theme: Dark Obsidian with Electric Cyan & Subtle Teal Accents
design_principles: Boardroom-Safe Minimalism: Ultra-crisp typography, rich high-contrast dark surfaces, restrained electric cyan highlights.
Mobile-First Speed: One-tap access to vCard, LinkedIn, WhatsApp, and Full-Screen QR code designed for fast trade show floor exchange.
Dynamic Context Integration: Multi-select Interest Chips that inject selected topics directly into outgoing WhatsApp and Email messages.
Optical Precision: Crisp 1px subtle borders, backdrop blurs, tactile press feedback, and zero visual clutter.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-slate-900/80 border border-slate-800/80 shadow-2xl shadow-cyan-950/20
visual_enhancers.card_style: rounded-2xl bg-slate-900/90 border border-slate-800 p-5 transition-all duration-200 hover:border-slate-700
visual_enhancers.button_primary: w-full py-3.5 px-5 rounded-xl bg-cyan-500 hover:bg-cyan-400 text-slate-950 font-semibold text-sm flex items-center justify-center gap-2.5 transition-all duration-150 shadow-lg shadow-cyan-500/20 active:scale-[0.98]
visual_enhancers.button_secondary: w-full py-3.5 px-5 rounded-xl bg-slate-800/90 hover:bg-slate-800 text-slate-100 border border-slate-700/80 font-medium text-sm flex items-center justify-center gap-2.5 transition-all duration-150 active:scale-[0.98]
visual_enhancers.chip_unselected: px-3.5 py-2 rounded-lg bg-slate-800/60 border border-slate-700/60 text-slate-300 text-xs font-medium cursor-pointer transition-all hover:bg-slate-800 hover:border-slate-600 active:scale-95

key_components_to_build.name: EventBadgeHeader
key_components_to_build.description: Configurable top banner displaying GISEC 2026 (Dubai Exhibition Centre) delegate badge with live status indicator and quick QR trigger.

key_components_to_build.name: ExecutiveProfileCard
key_components_to_build.description: Profile header with circular avatar placeholder (icon fallback / RM initials toggle), Raghu M's title, organization, clearance tags, and contact copy actions.

key_components_to_build.name: PrimaryActionGrid
key_components_to_build.description: Quick access action buttons: Save Contact (.vcf download), Connect on LinkedIn, Direct WhatsApp, and Direct Email.

key_components_to_build.name: InterestChipsSelector
key_components_to_build.description: Interactive multi-select chips (Zero-Trust, Sovereign AI, Threat Intelligence, etc.) that dynamically inject selected topics into WhatsApp and Email prefilled payloads.

key_components_to_build.name: QRCodeSection
key_components_to_build.description: Clean QR code display encoding vCard data / networking URL, complete with Download PNG button and Show Full Screen QR trigger.

key_components_to_build.name: FullScreenQRModal
key_components_to_build.description: High-contrast full-screen drawer/modal optimized for instant camera scanning under bright exhibition lighting with one-tap close.

key_components_to_build.name: NationLabsOverviewCard
key_components_to_build.description: Executive summary of NationLabs R&D focus areas, booth coordinates at GISEC 2026 (Hall 8, Stand H8-B40), and one-pager capability document trigger.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a mobile-first single-page React application (.js / .jsx) with no top navigation bar.
Use dark theme by default (Slate-950 base) with electric cyan (#00F0FF) accents and teal secondary highlights.
Ensure all buttons and interactive elements have data-testid attributes.
Implement vCard download using Blob URL containing standard vCard 3.0 string.
Dynamically update WhatsApp and Email direct links whenever interest chips are selected or unselected.
Provide toast notifications using Sonner when copying email/phone or downloading vCard.
Provide a dedicated full-screen QR modal component for trade show scanning.
